# windows-lsa

> Safe Rust access to the Windows Local Security Authority Kerberos
> authentication package and the current logon session's ticket cache.

- [README](https://github.com/icedracon/windows-lsa/blob/main/README.md)
- [API documentation](https://docs.rs/windows-lsa)
- [Ecosystem map](https://github.com/icedracon/win32-min/blob/master/ECOSYSTEM.md)
- [ABI foundation](https://github.com/icedracon/win32-min)

The crate wraps untrusted LSA connection, Kerberos package lookup, ticket-cache
query, ticket retrieval, KRB-CRED submission, and purge messages. It does not
decode ASN.1 or construct KRB-CRED wrappers from raw Ticket bytes.
